name: bndmax-dot-server
description: Standalone DNS-over-TLS (RFC 7858) server for Android's Private DNS field. Answers domains/IPs/ranges from the BNDMAX VPN worker's public /api/dns-rules list with a Cloudflare 'clean' IP, forwards everything else upstream untouched. Runs on a VPS — Cloudflare Workers cannot host a raw TLS listener on port 853.
